Submit repository

Use a repository URL or owner/repository. Only public repositories are supported. Submitting a repository suggests it for the shared catalogue; it does not verify ownership or guarantee a featured position. You must have permission to share any material you supply.

Your submissions

Each submission requests a dedicated scan. The queue is also checked every 15 minutes. GitHub queues or an active catalogue sync can delay the start. Temporary errors are retried. Accepted projects appear after catalogue publication. Dates and times are shown in your device’s time zone. Cancel a request while it is queued or waiting for a retry.

Submissions follow our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
